What this study establishes

  • Original Qwen3.5 recognizer and shipped Telugu-capable tokenizer.
  • Image and label verification, duplicate grouping, and frozen split checksums.
  • Finite gradients, changed adapter weights, tiny-subset learning and save/reload checks.
  • Word recognition on a bounded pilot, using source-provided ground truth.

What remains to be measured

  • Whole-page handwriting and layout accuracy.
  • Writer-disjoint generalization; writer identities are unverified.
  • Human review of source labels and near-duplicate groups.
  • Robustness to camera photos, faint ink and complex layouts.
